question: Find the value of p³ - r³, if p + r = 21, and pr = 38.
solution:
Given:

p + r = 21 and pr = 38

Concept used:

x3 + y3 = (x + y)3 - 3xy(x + y)

x + y = a, then x - y = √a² - 4xy

Calculation:

p + r = 21........(1)

Using x - y = √a2 - 4xy,

⇒ p - r = √21² - 4 × 38 

⇒ p - r = √289

⇒ p - r = 17........(2)

Solving equations (1) and (2),

We get p =19 and r = 2

⇒ p3 - r3

⇒ 19³ - 2³

⇒ 6859 - 8

⇒ 6851

∴​ The required answer is 6851.
